steps.en: Outstanding notices at the third reminder stage are collected for today's batch
steps.id: Notice outstanding di stage reminder ketiga dikumpulkan untuk batch hari ini

steps.en: The same company UEN across notices is recognised
steps.id: Uen company yang sama di beberapa notice dikenali
steps.why_en: The same company UEN can still get several messages when due dates differ.
steps.why_id: Uen company yang sama masih bisa dapat beberapa pesan bila due date berbeda.

steps.en: Only companies with an email address get the email
steps.id: Hanya company yang punya alamat email yang dapat email

steps.en: The email lists all outstanding notices of the company
steps.id: Email memuat semua notice outstanding milik company

steps.en: The email text refers to the third letter
steps.id: Teks email merujuk ke surat ketiga
steps.why_en: Only the template name follows the stage; the wording sits in the database.
steps.why_id: Hanya nama template yang mengikuti stage; isi kalimat ada di database.

steps.en: The email reminder is sent to the company
steps.why_en: Production has the scheduled job and email sending both switched off.
steps.why_id: Production mematikan job terjadwal dan pengiriman email.
